transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Lately, I've been experiencing some really strange things that I can't explain. I keep having these intense thoughts and beliefs that other people tell me aren't true, but they feel completely real to me. It feels like there are things going on behind the scenes that only I can see.
Have you also had periods of feeling unusually high or energized, or periods of feeling very depressed, around the same time as these beliefs?

Yes, actually. I've had periods lasting about a week where I feel incredibly high, energized, and hyperactive, like I'm constantly on the go. These intense, high-energy phases definitely happen at the same time as those beliefs I've been struggling with.
Have you ever had times when the beliefs or unusual perceptions continued even when your mood was back to normal and you were not feeling unusually high or depressed?

Yes, absolutely. There have been times lasting for at least two weeks where my mood felt completely stable and normal, but those strange beliefs and voices still didn't go away. Even when I wasn't feeling high or energized at all, the feeling of being monitored was still there.
How long have the mood episodes lasted compared with the times when the beliefs or voices were present?

I've been dealing with these struggles for about a year and eight months in total, and those high-energy mood phases have been present for most of that time. However, there were definitely a few weeks in there where my mood was completely normal, but the voices and beliefs were still happening on their own.

Based on what you’ve described, I’m concerned about schizoaffective disorder, bipolar type. I’d like to ask one more thing: during the times you felt unusually high or energized, did you also have decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, or impulsive behavior?
To be honest, I don't recall having a decreased need for sleep or racing thoughts during those periods. I also don't think I was engaging in any impulsive behaviors when my energy was high.
During those high-energy periods, did you still need your usual amount of sleep, or did you sleep much less and feel fine?
To be honest, I'm not really sure and haven't paid close attention to my sleep patterns during those times. I can't quite remember if I was sleeping less or if my sleep stayed the same.
Have there been any periods of at least 2 weeks when you felt very depressed, with low mood or loss of interest, and the voices or beliefs were still present even after your mood improved?

No, I have never had any periods of feeling depressed or losing interest in things. My mood has only ever been normal or on the high side, but I definitely still hear the voices and have those beliefs during the times when my mood is completely stable.
Have you ever had times when the beliefs or unusual perceptions continued even when your mood was back to normal and you were not feeling unusually high or depressed?

Yes, definitely. There have been periods of two weeks or more where my mood was completely stable and I felt like my normal self, but the voices and beliefs were still very much there. Even without the high energy, those strange experiences didn't go away.
Have there been any times when the voices or beliefs continued for at least 2 weeks while your mood was completely normal and you were not feeling unusually high or depressed?

Yes, absolutely. There have been times lasting at least two weeks where my mood was completely normal and stable, but I still heard the voices and had those beliefs. Even without any high energy or depression, those experiences remained.
Have you ever had times when the beliefs or unusual perceptions continued even when your mood was back to normal and you were not feeling unusually high or depressed?

Yes, I definitely have. There were times lasting for about two weeks where my mood felt completely stable and normal, but the voices and the feeling of being monitored didn't go away. Even without the high energy, those strange experiences remained.
